summary: A navigation guide to the history, rubber-guard and bottom-half sections of Eddie Bravo’s The Ultimate Rubber Guard.
description: Choose an entry point into Eddie Bravo’s advertised guard material according to whether you want context, rubber guard or bottom half.
overview: A school’s no-gi curriculum can be much broader than one release. This page helps you select a route through the linked course and points to more focused companion pages when you already know your subject.

guide.display_title: Eddie Bravo: Choosing a Guard Study Route

fits: You are unsure which part of the linked Eddie Bravo release matches your current interest.
consider_alternative_if: For a direct rubber-guard study route, use the Rubber Guard guide; for the brief half-guard section, use Bottom Half Study.

includes: Historical discussion precedes rubber-guard material; bottom half appears in the final volume.
limits: The published outline does not list a truck or twister curriculum, nor a complete open-guard program.

start_here.title: Choose context or positional study
start_here.task: Compare the first volume’s historical headings with the positional headings in volumes 3 and 4. Select one of three routes: background, rubber guard, or bottom half. If your goal is open guard against a standing passer, compare the Marcelo X-Guard guide instead.

sources.title: The Ultimate Rubber Guard by Eddie Bravo
sources.note: Verified four volumes, instructor, rubber-guard history and omoplata coverage, and the Bottom Half section. Listing inspected; course video content not reviewed.

sources.title: The Marcelo X Guard by Marcelo Garcia
sources.note: Verified butterfly/shin-to-shin entries, sleeve/collar examples, stand-up finishes and pummel/backstep counters. Listing inspected; course video content not reviewed.
